scenes.stage_direction: Adrian's surviving records reopen grief. Leave a pause around Amara's response; David does not speak over it.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: The instruction is authenticated. It can support the action for Ethan.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Even if it cannot tell me who killed his father.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: We keep that question open. This instruction needs an answer now.

metadata.evidence_summary: It supports action for Ethan without solving the death.
